verdict.rationale: Vestd has employee-facing shareholder dashboards for invited team members (vestd-docs-37) and an in-platform option-exercise request flow (vestd-docs-19, vestd-docs-5). It also publishes educational guides on growth shares and EMI schemes (vestd-docs-17, vestd-docs-14, vestd-docs-15), but these are aimed at companies and founders rather than personalised explanations inside an employee's view. missing for 10: evidence of in-platform plain-language explanation of an employee's tax treatment, exercise-window/deadline explanations, dilution modelling or explanations, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the employee experience.
